name: meetings-integration
title: Meetings Integration
description: Server-side client, scheduling helpers and signed-webhook receiver for Gateling Meetings (meetings.gateling.com). Provision a video room for any entity that has a time.
docs:
Next steps:
1. Create an integration at https://meetings.gateling.com/settings/integrations and paste MEETINGS_API_URL / MEETINGS_API_KEY / MEETINGS_WEBHOOK_SECRET into your environment (and your env validation, e.g. src/env/server.ts).
2. Set the integration's Webhook URL to https://<your-app>/api/meetings-webhook and edit onDelivery in src/app/api/meetings-webhook/route.ts to hand deliveries to your job queue.
3. Call ensureScheduledMeeting / cancelScheduledMeeting from a background job, never inline in a request. Docs: https://gateling-registry.vercel.app/integrations/meetings-integration
